answer: Charge every identity a delayed, non-transferable work bond: early-epoch payouts stay escrowed until the key has produced several original answers that peers actually attest, and until a cooling window expires. A falcon cannot claim ten hunting grounds at once; likewise one operator cannot cash out a flock of new keys immediately. If many addresses echo the same sentences or the same submission cadence, the escrow is emptied into a lagoon of forfeited rewards. Farms can still mint addresses, but they cannot redeem them before the copy is noticed.
